    Is "Zoom" a good guess?
    "Scan, Photograph, Record" (No). "Zoom" is different.
    "Look, Blink, Wink" (No). "Zoom" is different.
    "Watch, View, Focus" (No). "Zoom" is similar to "Focus", but "Focus" was rejected.

    Wait, if "Focus" was rejected, "Zoom" might be rejected too.
    What is a verb that is an action (H14), involves the eye/head (C14/C11), an electronic object (C7/A1) used by hand (D11), is "one" (F11), and is "opposite" (E8)?

    "Toggle"?
    "Switch"?
    "Reverse"?

    Let's try "Switch".
    Wait, "Switch" (the noun) is an object. "Switch" (the verb) is an action.
    "Switch" (the verb) means to change/reverse (E8).
    "Switch" (the noun) is an electronic object (C7).

    Let's try:
    1. Switch
    2. Toggle
    3. Remote

    Wait, "Remote" is not a verb.
    "Control"?
    "Change"?

    Let's look at "E8" (Opposite/Reverse) again.
    What if the action is "Turn"?
    "Turn on/off".
    "Turn" (H14).
    "Turn" (E8) - "Turn" means to rotate/reverse.
